column3: NASB sets the title in braces before verse 1. Close to the Hebrew.
The written Hebrew has “you (feminine) said”; NASB reads “I said,” and renders “my good is not upon You” as “I have no good besides You.”
The Hebrew is difficult; NASB renders “the holy ones” as “the saints” and “in the land” as “in the earth.” The meaning is uncertain.
“Who hurried after another” is rendered “who have bartered for another god,” with “god” supplied; “drink offerings from blood” is rendered “libations of blood.” The meaning is uncertain.
Close to the Hebrew; “You are holding my lot” is rendered “You support my lot.”
Close to the Hebrew; “my kidneys” is rendered “my mind,” and “nights” as “in the night.”
Close to the Hebrew; “my honor” is rendered “my glory.”
“Your faithful one” is rendered “Your Holy One,” and “to see the pit” as “to undergo decay.”
Close to the Hebrew; “abundance of gladnesses” is rendered “fulness of joy.”
